title: Full stops and commas
summary: Learn to use full stops and commas to write clear Spanish texts.
keyIdeas: A full stop (.) ends a statement. The next sentence begins with a capital letter.
A comma (,) separates items in a list and can mark a short pause.
Before the last item in a Spanish list, we usually write 'y' (and) instead of a comma.

basicKnowledge: D. Reflexión sobre la lengua y sus usos en el marco de propuestas la producción y comprensión de textos orales, escritos o multimodales

activities.prompt: Which mark ends the Spanish sentence «Hoy llueve»?
activities.explanation: A full stop ends this statement.
activities.hint: It is a small round mark at the end of the sentence.

activities.prompt: We use commas to separate things in a list.
activities.explanation: Correct! Commas separate words or items in a list.

activities.prompt: Choose the word to complete this Spanish rule.
activities.explanation: The first word of a new sentence begins with a capital letter.
activities.sentence: Después del punto que cierra una oración, la siguiente comienza con ___.

activities.prompt: Match each mark or capital letter to its main job.
activities.explanation: Full stops end statements, commas separate list items and capital letters begin new sentences.

activities.prompt: Hugo packs his pencil case. Which Spanish sentence has correct punctuation?
activities.explanation: Commas separate the items in the list. The last item is joined with «y».
activities.hint: Look at the marks between the objects in the pencil case.
options: Tengo lápiz goma sacapuntas y tijeras.
Tengo lápiz. goma. sacapuntas. y tijeras.
Tengo lápiz, goma, sacapuntas y tijeras.

activities.prompt: Sort the Spanish sentences by whether a comma or full stop is missing at [?].
activities.explanation: Use a comma between items in a list and a full stop between two complete statements.

items.text: El perro corre [?] Luego bebe agua.
Aisha tiene cromos [?] muñecas y peonzas.
Hoy sale el sol [?] El cielo está azul.

activities.prompt: Find the Spanish sentence with a punctuation mistake.
activities.explanation: After the full stop in «fruta.», «luego» needs a capital letter: «Luego».
activities.hint: Check the letter after the full stop.
options: Lucía juega, salta y ríe en el patio.
Omar come fruta. luego lee su libro favorito.
El gato duerme en el sofá.

activities.prompt: Put these parts in order to make a correctly punctuated Spanish sentence.
activities.explanation: Begin with where we keep the objects, then list the notebook, pencils and ruler.

activities.prompt: Read the Spanish text carefully and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The text uses commas to list vegetables and full stops to separate four statements.
activities.title: La huerta del colegio
activities.text: En el huerto del cole plantamos tomates, lechugas, zanahorias y cebollas. Cada día regamos la tierra con cuidado. Las plantas crecen muy rápido bajo el sol brillante. Pronto prepararemos una ensalada rica y sana con la cosecha.

questions.prompt: Why are there commas in the first sentence?
questions.explanation: The commas separate the vegetables in the list.
options: Because the whole sentence has ended.
Because they separate the vegetables planted in the garden.
Because each vegetable is followed by a capital letter.

questions.prompt: How many complete sentences end with a full stop?
questions.explanation: There are 4 sentences, each ending with a full stop.
